item.title: The Paranormal Is Among Us: Are We Really Alone? (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Paul Anthony has always had a fascination with broadcasting and the paranormal. With a degree in Broadcasting from Webster University in St. Louis, Missouri, and nearly five years of podcasting experience, this passionate broadcaster has developed a diverse background in entertainment and media. Although family responsibilities initially led to stepping away from broadcasting, a renewed passion for the industry sparked a return through podcasting. Early projects included the fitness-focused Shed It, along with sports programs St. Louis Sports Scene and St. Louis High School Sports Scene. After experimenting with a general-interest podcast alongside friends, the journey eventually led to the creation of Paranormal Among Us.

A lifelong fascination with the unexplained inspired the move into paranormal broadcasting. From ghost stories and haunted locations to UFO sightings, extraterrestrial encounters, and mysterious cryptids, years of watching paranormal television programs and reading books about the supernatural helped fuel this passion. Through Paranormal Among Us, the goal is to explore the strange, mysterious, and often unbelievable stories that continue to challenge our understanding of the world around us.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
